decisions.otherFlpDecision: EYW, GNV and MLB require new SYR service or new northeast feeders. None qualifies as a trivial retime; no expansion to those three is included. Existing FLL/PIE/SFB/SRQ two-way coverage is retained.
decisions.rotationRebalance: Insert the closed PGD–DAB–PGD two-day segment on AS. Transfer the existing R352 RDU–DAY day to AK, add PHF–RDU before it and RDU–PHF before R326. AS closes in 12 days, AK in 10; original maintenance nights remain legal.
decisions.sameFleetExchange: Exchange the HPN and ALB round trips between R106 and R131, returning both aircraft to SYR at their unchanged 18:54 arrival. Move the ROC morning turn from R125 to R159 to free the earlier PVD flight.
decisions.tradeoffScope: Holistic lower-demand changes are authorized. Coverage losses and slower fastest journeys are explicitly reported; this round does not claim zero network regressions.

limitations: O-D values and opportunity indices measure eligible markets, not bookings, aircraft loads or proven profitability.

Every flight uses the pinned CRJ700 block-time model; no new bank, connection-window, curfew, fleet or physical-inventory waiver is introduced. Existing approved useful-hub exceptions remain in force for PGD and DAB.

This is a deliberate coverage tradeoff: all original flight IDs and fleets remain, but 13 clocks and named same-fleet round-trip assignments change. Slower fastest journeys and lost options are reported without claiming a regression-free network.
Some new one-stop itineraries are slower than retained two-stop choices. Both are available.
EYW, GNV and MLB need new service rather than trivial adjustments; that expansion is not included.
